c74object.name: ambitap.grid~
c74object.digest: Soundfield energy heatmap analysis for a HOA bus (equirectangular grid)
c74object.description: Soundfield energy heatmap analysis for a HOA bus (equirectangular grid). The bus passes through; bang outputs the smoothed grid as a list for the AmbiTap v8ui heatmap widget. Order is a creation argument.

attribute.name: azimuth_steps
attribute.digest: Grid azimuth resolution (columns; rows are half)
attribute.description: Grid azimuth resolution (columns; rows are half). Rounded to even, 4-128. Rebuilds the SH table on the control thread.

attribute.name: smoothing_time
attribute.digest: Per-direction energy smoothing time constant, milliseconds
attribute.description: Per-direction energy smoothing time constant, milliseconds.

attribute.name: dynamic_range
attribute.digest: Display dynamic range in dB below the peak mapped to 0..1
attribute.description: Display dynamic range in dB below the peak mapped to 0..1.
